description: This file defines the Faq class for managing FAQ entries within a SugarCRM-based system, including methods for comments handling, report query generation, and module relations.

classes.name: Faq
classes.description: Represents FAQ entries, manages comments, report queries, and module relations within the CRM system.

methods.name: Faq
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves the FAQ module data and inserts comments into the related table.

methods.name: insertIntoFAQCommentTable
methods.description: Inserts a comment into the vtiger_faqcomments table for a specific FAQ.

methods.name: getFAQComments
methods.description: Retrieves and formats comments related to a specific FAQ as HTML.

methods.name: generateReportsQuery
methods.description: Generates the primary SQL query part for reporting on FAQ data.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules, e.g., Documents.

methods.name: clearSingletonSaveFields
methods.description: Clears the comments field in the column_fields array.
